trigger.condition: Player talks to Vance at big_top, or examines the shady_productions_fax object at shady_productions_office

sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_vance_vallaro_01
sequence.dialogue: You want to be on TELEVISION? Shady Productions, folding table's right behind the big top. The Bacchanus Beach Beatdown, Season 22. Walk the gear path down to Fauxst Beach on the Bohemian Riviera, tell 'em Vance sent you - (exhale) - not that it gets you anything. Just tell 'em anyway.

post_event_effects.note: This event is a foreshadowing/routing pointer only. It does NOT grant quest_start, does NOT open a sign-up flow, and does NOT duplicate any Beatdown mechanic. The actual quest origin (debaucheryville_sidequest_bacchanus_beach_beatdown_01, role quest_origin) is Petra at signup_table on the Bohemian Riviera, per bacchanusbeachbeatdown.md and bohemian_riviera_location_nodes.json. This matches cirque_du_shady.md's own framing: 'this office is flavor, foreshadowing, and the beatdown_aware state trigger, not a second quest-start point.'

trigger.condition: icq_backroom zone, evening-night hours (18:00-01:00), random chance; most likely after dark per cirque_du_shady.md Time-of-Day Variations

sequence.description: A random Darkweb Dossier 'hack-through' pop-in intrudes on the ICQ terminal, sharing the same ICQ substrate and at least one handle (Tony420) with the bacchanusbeachbeatdown.md ICQ Scammer Sting cast.

events.note: Hook-level cross-reference to the ICQ Scammer Sting questline per cirque_du_shady.md Quest Integration; no new Darkweb Dossier content is authored here.

interactive_objects.description: Grants access to further paid attractions, nothing else. A hand-cranked ticket dispenser jams on purpose - per the attendant, 'builds anticipation.'

Overlapping flyers: Prophecy Roulette hours (cross-references hamstradamus.md, not re-specified here), a faded Vanishing Elephant 'Bubbles' missing-pet-style poster (the elephant is still, technically, on the premises - Vanishing Elephant sidequest hook per debaucheryville.md/game_design_document.md, not designed here), and one current Shady Productions casting flyer, curling at the corners.

easter_egg.reveal: The Vanishing Elephant ('Bubbles') sidequest hook - recover the elephant before he's sold to a questionable nightclub. Hook only, not designed in this document.

interactive_objects.description: A fax machine that predates the current millennium by a comfortable margin, humming behind the big top's canvas wall. It periodically spits a Casting-Call Flyer - the same flyer, every time, reading 'WANTED: ATHLETIC-INTELLECTUAL HYBRID. CARGO SHORTS PREFERRED. NO EXPERIENCE NECESSARY.' A hand-lettered sign taped to it reads 'SHADY PRODUCTIONS - HOME OF THE BACCHANUS BEACH BEATDOWN - SEASON 22.'

easter_egg.reveal: The same flyer, every time, prints out as though it were written specifically for the reader. It has fed out of the same fax machine for twenty-two seasons.

interactive_objects.description: A shrink-wrapped merchandise pallet stamped 2003, visible at the tent-flap edge of shady_productions_office - the same pallet documented at Fauxst Beach in bohemian_riviera.md, evidently the overflow storage location for the same physical merchandise stock split across two storage locations.

interactive_objects.interaction_text: Play the milk bottle toss (3 Sovs)
interactive_objects.description: Milk bottles filled with concrete. Average yield 5-15 tickets per 3 Sovs game, statistically worse than the prize costs, feeding directly into prize_booth's ticket-tier economy.
Oversized rings against undersized bottle necks. Average yield 5-15 tickets per 3 Sovs game.
A coin-pusher tilted three degrees off level. Average yield 5-15 tickets per 3 Sovs game.

interactive_objects.interaction_text: Buy a Shady Loot Crate Voucher
interactive_objects.description: Vance pitches and sells the voucher here at big_top; fulfillment happens at prize_booth, where Yolanda hands over the crate. Two-zone transaction by design, per cirque_du_shady.md Economic Integration.

environmental_interactions.effect: icq_backroom's night CRT-glow state signals the hack-through event is more likely after dark; see events.icq_hackthrough_popin

rewards.failure: No penalty specified (deferred to future pass)

visit_2_plus.note: Hamstradamus delivers his 'BACK AGAIN. GOOD.' callback line. Vance treats every walk-up as a potential talent discovery regardless of visit count, per cirque_du_shady.md Buffoon Delusion Scenarios.

narrator_commentary.on_entering: Old Town cobblestones give way to trampled grass and sawdust well before the gate itself is visible - the smell arrives first.
narrator_commentary.on_key_moment: The ticket booth's sign says 'everything else extra' in plain English before they've paid for anything, and it changes nothing about what a bro chooses to believe he's walking into.
narrator_commentary.on_exit: The dome is visible from streets away, faded red-and-cream, and has clearly not moved, in any literal sense, in a very long time.
